name: Elder Grove · Moss Shrine
_design: Elder Grove zone (level-designer 2026-11-24; zone elder_tree, order 4). Generated by tools/maps/build_elder_grove.gd (edit the script, not this file): the goblin courtyard board (same bounds, spawns, no cover) on a floating island deep in an ancient giant-tree forest: mossy loam board, cushion-moss margins, walls of rotting stumps and gnarled roots north/east/west, an open cliff in front with ferns and mushrooms only, soft green-gold sunlight baked as dapples through the leaves. The old moss shrine of the Grove Warden sits on a stepped stone dais in the middle of the north wall, lit by two stone lanterns and green runes; the elder tree rises from the north-east corner and a small vine arch opens the west wall. Stepping stones circle the middle of the board, flat roots cross it, ferns and mushrooms on the open front cliff. Monster ids here are a PLACEHOLDER fixture (family-neutral old monsters: the elder family does not exist yet); the zone's journey will bring the real waves onto the spots in list order.
_arena: Board 16 x 9 m, the goblin courtyard's (same spawns, no cover: logic/auto_pilot.gd walks straight at its target). Nothing stands on the board (roots and stones on it are flat inlays under 0.1 m); trees, walls and the shrine are on the island margins, the front (camera side) is an open cliff.
_spots: Spot roles in order: melee, melee, melee, melee, knight, melee, archer, mage
